authors_reviews.author: Cyndie A. Flanagan

authors_reviews.title: Smaller than I expected, but absolutely adorable and worth it
authors_reviews.text: This is so cute. It’s a little bit smaller than what I expected, but it’s absolutely a great value for the money. It’s a perfect gift. Since they are all keychains. I’m using the Base basket for my boo basket. And then I have five other keychain characters to give to my little special trick-or-treaters in my neighborhood.
authors_reviews.author: Bruce

authors_reviews.title: Cute Keychains to handout for Coworkers.
authors_reviews.text: So, I purchased to hand out to staff.They are well made. The box it’s packaged in, is adorable.It’s really cute…someone mentioned they’re small. But …I mean…it’s a keychain. They are palm size, well stuffed…not flat or stitched lopsided. The lil orange plush tray is off though. My one complaint is that the chain part of it, is weak. So have to be careful of you may end up loosing you boo buddy if it snags. I did a first purchase then my second purchase it had went up about a buck and some change. They really are stinkin cute.
authors_reviews.author: Kindle Customer

authors_reviews.title: Amazing find and cute
authors_reviews.text: This Basket stuffers are amazing. The kids loved them my daughter kept the small little basket where they come and filled it with candy by the entrance of the door. Definitely amazing thinking. They are so soft and cute and it wasn’t crazy expensive compared to others out there.
authors_reviews.author: Karina P.

authors_reviews.title: Cute
authors_reviews.text: The stuffers are cute, but smaller than expected. I didn’t realize they were key rings. Unfortunately, several of the rings came a part. Easy to repair. I do not recommend these for little ones due them coming a part.
authors_reviews.author: Sherri Harris

authors_reviews.title: So cute for a Boo Basket
authors_reviews.text: These are adorable! I got them for a Halloween boo basket and they were exactly the size listed. They’re small, soft, and really cute in person, and I love that they can be used as keychains too. The little ghost is probably my favorite. Such a fun Halloween gift and definitely something I’d buy again.
